title: Chaucer's Vocabulary — Layers
subtitle: Germanic core, French overlay, Latin learned words.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Germanic core (go, come, good, man, wife). French overlay (courtesy, honour, service, gentle, royal). Latin learned words (devout, compassion, conscience, piteous). You learn to hear the register. The high style uses French and Latin; the low style uses Germanic words.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Chaucer's Vocabulary — Layers.
